VERIFY every value against each provider's current published terms before enabling — referral rates, payout thresholds and payout methods change frequently, and several fields here are the difference between a Nepali creator getting paid or not. Fields marked VERIFY are best-effort from secondary sources.

credentials.label: App secret
credentials.help: BitLabs dashboard → your app → Settings → App secret. We verify the hash on every postback with it, and never show it again after you save.

steps: Sign up at BitLabs in your own name — the publisher account has to be yours, because the money is paid to you and not to us.
Create an app for this store there, and set its payout method and country. Their minimum applies to you, not to us.
In the app settings, set the postback URL below. The macros in it are theirs; leave the braces exactly as they are.
Paste the app secret here and save. Until then the connection stays unverified and no postback from them is accepted.

params.note: Our reference for the viewer, which is what the unlock is tied to.
Their transaction id. A repeat is ignored, so their retry cannot unlock twice.
Points, as they send them. Informational.
Currency value where their macro provides one. Informational: it is never blended into your statement figure.
Which unlock this callback satisfies. Without it the callback is verified and then discarded.

signature.detail: Hex digest appended last as &hash=. Nothing may be URL-encoded before hashing: the hash covers the URI as sent, and a re-encoded macro changes it.

credentials.label: App secret
credentials.help: PubScale dashboard → your app → Settings → secret. Used to verify the MD5 signature on every callback.

steps: Sign up at PubScale in your own name and add this store as an app.
Set the callback URL below in their dashboard, with the macros as written.
Paste the app secret here and save.
Their server retries six times when it does not get a 2xx. We answer 200 to a callback we have already processed, so a retry is never a second unlock and never a second payment.

params.note: Their reward value. Truncated to an integer before the signature — their rule, not ours.
Their transaction id, and what makes their retries idempotent.

signature.covers: secret, a dot, user_id, a dot, int(value), a dot, token
signature.detail: In that order, concatenated literally. Value is truncated, not rounded.

nepalPayoutWarnings: Payoneer IS fully operational in Nepal (verified) - 1-3 business days to a Nepali bank, NPR, ~2% conversion. Earlier caution on this was too strong.
Payoneer carries a USD 29.95/yr fee if annual income is under USD 2,000. For a micro-creator earning USD 50/yr that is ~60% of earnings. DISCLOSE THIS in the picker.
Skrill reaches NPR via eSewa at ~1.45% - this makes LOW thresholds reachable. PropellerAds/Adcash are $5 via Skrill, not $20.
PayPal remains unusable for receiving in Nepal.
A domestic Nepali ad network exists (AdMana) - NPR rails, no forex.
INDIA CONTRAST: Indian publishers get AdSense EFT at ~Rs 1,000; Nepal gets wire at $100. Adgebra pays INR 5,000 (~$60) globally.
Prefer: NPR-domestic rails > Payoneer/Skrill > wire. Avoid: PayPal-only, crypto-only.

payoutMethodSemantics._why: A provider's advertised minimum is almost always the cheapest METHOD, not the method a Nepali user can actually use. PropellerAds advertises $5 (PayPal/Skrill) but Payoneer needs $20; wire needs $550.

fields.payoutMethods[].nepalUsable: true = evidenced usable from Nepal. false = evidenced unusable. VERIFY = unknown, must not be presented as usable.
fields.payoutMethods[].minUsd: Minimum for THAT method. null = no stated minimum.
fields.minPayoutUsd: Advertised headline minimum. Reference only — never show this to a Nepali user as their threshold.

payoutMethodSemantics.rule: The provider picker must show the Nepal-reachable minimum, or say 'unknown'. Never the advertised one.

verified2026.payoneer: Fully operational in Nepal. Withdraw to any commercial Nepali bank, 1-3 business days, NPR, ~2% conversion. INBOUND ONLY - NRB restricts outward remittance. USD 29.95/yr fee under USD 2,000 annual income.
verified2026.skrill: Reaches NPR via eSewa at ~1.45%. Makes low thresholds usable.
verified2026.paypal: Still not usable for RECEIVING in Nepal.
verified2026.meta_facebook: Now pays Nepali creators directly to local NPR bank accounts. Relevant to audience, not to slot inventory.
